<br>
<font size="4"><font color="#800080">先说说病毒攻击主要是伪装成正常文件执行，</font></font><br>
<font size="4"><font color="#800080">或者通过下载器下载一些扫描工具，攻击程序，</font></font><br>
<font size="4"><font color="#800080">然后在本机后台悄悄运行，</font></font><br>
<font size="4"><font color="#ff0000">我们要做的就是杜绝不明程序运行，</font></font><br>
<font size="4"><font color="#ff0000">只允许白名单程序运行，</font></font><br>
<font size="4"><font color="#800080">这样安全就提升很多。</font></font><br>
<strong><font face="微软雅黑"><font size="4"><font color="#2f4f4f">操作步骤：</font></font></font></strong><br>
<font size="4"><font color="#2f4f4f"><strong><font face="微软雅黑">第一步：先安装火绒安全软件</font></strong></font></font><br>
<font size="4"><font color="#2f4f4f"><strong><font face="微软雅黑">第二步：运行cmd 输入tasklist /v &gt; d:\程序进程.txt&nbsp;&nbsp;打开获取所有程序进程名称，把已知正常的进程添加到下面的组策略中</font></strong></font></font><br>
<strong><font face="微软雅黑"><font size="4"><font color="#2f4f4f">第三步</font></font></font></strong><font size="4"><font color="#2f4f4f"><strong><font face="微软雅黑">：</font></strong></font></font><strong><font face="微软雅黑"><font size="4"><font color="#2f4f4f">添加组策略程序白名单。</font></font></font></strong><font size="4"><font color="#2f4f4f"><strong><font face="微软雅黑">1、按键盘WIN+R打开运行，输入gpedit.msc，打开本地组策略</font></strong></font></font><br>
<font size="4"><img id="aimg_U91al" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://chinakb.lenovo.com.cn/chinakb/prod-api/file/downloadFile?key=uniko/IMAGE/72d856dcc57bcd80414599d6e61167fa-1767083546612.png&amp;name=mceclip0.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://chinakb.lenovo.com.cn/chinakb/prod-api/file/downloadFile?key=uniko/IMAGE/72d856dcc57bcd80414599d6e61167fa-1767083546612.png&amp;name=mceclip0.png"></font><br>
<font size="4">2、在路径：用户配置-管理模版-系统，找到只运行指定的windows应用程序，点击策略设置如下图：</font><br>
<font size="4"><img id="aimg_Qt0pp" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://chinakb.lenovo.com.cn/chinakb/prod-api/file/downloadFile?key=uniko/IMAGE/d115157fe20e3a58bf9f702e486d0c1f-1767083562238.png&amp;name=mceclip1.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://chinakb.lenovo.com.cn/chinakb/prod-api/file/downloadFile?key=uniko/IMAGE/d115157fe20e3a58bf9f702e486d0c1f-1767083562238.png&amp;name=mceclip1.png"></font><font size="4"> </font><font size="4"><br>
</font><br>
<font size="4">3、点击“已启用”再点击“显示”，这里输入指定程序名。</font><font size="4">以微信为例：Weixin.exe。另外还需要输入mmc.exe和cmd.exe否则后续无法打开组策略修改配置！设置好后点击确定，关闭组策略。</font><br>
<font size="4"><img id="aimg_wo5Gv" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://chinakb.lenovo.com.cn/chinakb/prod-api/file/downloadFile?key=uniko/IMAGE/e25d3696c41654d56ca7f8153e0c242c-1767083572853.png&amp;name=mceclip2.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://chinakb.lenovo.com.cn/chinakb/prod-api/file/downloadFile?key=uniko/IMAGE/e25d3696c41654d56ca7f8153e0c242c-1767083572853.png&amp;name=mceclip2.png"></font><font size="4"> </font><font size="4"><br>
</font><br>
<font size="4">4、再次打开其他软件时，会有下图的提示，至此设置完成。如需恢复返回到组策略原位置，勾选未配置即可。</font><br>
<font size="4"><img id="aimg_frPxK" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://chinakb.lenovo.com.cn/chinakb/prod-api/file/downloadFile?key=uniko/IMAGE/1e46c6e66c48cc9c61b84955df923082-1767083577742.png&amp;name=mceclip3.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://chinakb.lenovo.com.cn/chinakb/prod-api/file/downloadFile?key=uniko/IMAGE/1e46c6e66c48cc9c61b84955df923082-1767083577742.png&amp;name=mceclip3.png"></font><br>
<strong><font size="4"><font color="#2f4f4f">第四步</font></font><font size="4"><font color="#2f4f4f"><font face="微软雅黑">：</font></font></font><font size="4"><font color="#2f4f4f">把火绒安全规则都打开，能自动阻止的都启用，包括禁止修改注册表和组策略</font></font></strong><br>
<strong><font size="4"><font color="#2f4f4f"><br>
</font></font></strong><br>
<strong><font size="4"><font color="#ff0000">如后续添加组策略规则记得先把火绒系统加固关闭否则无法修改组策略。</font></font></strong><img id="aimg_hfTI1" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://attach.52pojie.cn//forum/202605/18/104606gpdy33kf7c7fcfhd.jpg?l" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://attach.52pojie.cn//forum/202605/18/104606gpdy33kf7c7fcfhd.jpg?l"><br>
<img id="aimg_QJAJA" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://attach.52pojie.cn//forum/202605/18/150140evjjkdzckb0bluz3.jpg?l" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://attach.52pojie.cn//forum/202605/18/150140evjjkdzckb0bluz3.jpg?l"><br>
